{{Quote|I-I must keep moving. Must warn others!|Leebo Nobim|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Leebo Nobim''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] colonist residing on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] his camp was attacked by [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] from the [[Unstoppable Horde]] and Leebo retreated to the [[Outpost Cresh]]. He later asked a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] individual to deal with his problem.
